panel.title: Request an appointment with {name}
panel.voluntary: Non-binding. {name} decides freely whether an appointment takes place.
panel.emptyText: {name} has no free times in the calendar for the next two weeks.
panel.closedTitle: No appointment requests at the moment
panel.closedText: This profile is not accepting appointment requests at the moment.

form.dayHint: Only days with free times in the next two weeks
form.durationHint: Free for up to {until} from this time
form.regionHint: A general region, never an address
form.signInNote: You sign in to send. Your entries are kept.
form.lostTime: The time from your draft is no longer free. Choose another one.

errors.network: The request was not sent because the connection is interrupted. Your entries are kept; try again.
errors.not-found: This profile cannot be reached at the moment.
errors.not-allowed: This profile is not accepting appointment requests at the moment.
errors.own-profile: You cannot request an appointment on your own profile.
errors.undeliverable: A request to this profile is not possible at the moment.
errors.invalid: The entries could not be checked. Choose day, time and duration again.
errors.invalidRegion: This region is no longer approved. Choose another one or «Not specified».
errors.unavailable: This time is no longer free. The choices are updated; choose another one.
errors.too-soon: This time is too close. Choose a later one.
errors.too-far: Requests this far ahead are not possible. Choose an earlier time.
errors.duplicate: A request to this profile is already open. You find it under «Appointments».
errors.rate-limited: You sent many requests in a short time. Try again in an hour.
errors.sign-in: Your session has expired. Sign in again; your entries are kept.

sent.title: Request sent
sent.text: {name} now sees it in the conversation and decides freely. You will be notified as soon as something changes.

counter.title: Propose another time
counter.descriptionMember: Choose one of the free times. {name} decides freely about the proposal.
counter.descriptionProvider: Propose a time that suits you. {name} can accept or cancel it.
counter.noSlots: No free times are entered at the moment.
counter.outOfRange: Choose a day within the next 90 days.
counter.notOnStep: Choose a time in steps of 15 minutes.

act.reportAfterSafety: The request is cancelled. Report {name} if you feel unsafe: the moderation team receives a copy of the last ten messages and does not learn who reported.

errors.invalid: These entries do not work. Check date, time and duration.
errors.not-allowed: This is no longer possible in the current status. The view now shows the latest state.
errors.conflict: Another appointment is already confirmed at this time. Propose another time.
errors.unavailable: This time is no longer free. Choose another one.
errors.stale: The request was just changed. Check the new state, then decide.
errors.sign-in: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.rate-limited: You made a lot of changes in a short time. Try again in an hour.
errors.network: The connection is interrupted. Nothing was changed; try again.

cancel.title: Cancel request?
cancel.description: Cancelling is final. {name} sees «Cancelled» and your reason if you give one. A reason is not required.

cancelConfirmed.title: Cancel appointment?
cancelConfirmed.description: Cancelling is final. {name} sees «Cancelled» and your reason if you give one. A reason is not required.

decline.title: Decline request?
decline.description: Declining is final. {name} sees «Declined» and your reason if you give one.

cancelSafety.title: Cancel for safety reasons?
cancelSafety.description: The request is cancelled immediately and for good. {name} only sees «Cancelled», with no hint about the reason. Afterwards you can report {name} to the moderation team.

dispute.title: Report as disputed?
dispute.description: «Disputed» is final and visible to {name}. Briefly describe what was not right, if you like.

offen.title: No open requests
offen.text: Requests awaiting a reply appear here. You send a request with «Request appointment» on a profile.

bestaetigt.title: No confirmed appointments
bestaetigt.text: As soon as a request is confirmed, the appointment appears here, the next one first.

vergangen.title: Nothing past yet
vergangen.text: Past, cancelled, declined and expired requests appear here.

detail.title: Appointment request to {name}
detail.voluntary: Every appointment request is voluntary. You can always cancel, without giving a reason.
detail.reviewsLater: Reviews after an appointment come with one of the next versions of the platform.

state.slow: This is taking longer than usual.
state.errorTitle: The appointments could not be loaded.
state.errorDescription: Your requests and appointments are unchanged.
